gentle.title: A twenty-minute walk today
gentle.detail: An easy twenty minutes — let your breath rise. Outside is nice, but anywhere counts.

coach.title: 20-minute brisk walk
coach.detail: Twenty minutes at a pace that warms you up. Steady breath, light sweat — that's the zone.

firm_direct.title: 20 minutes. Brisk. Walk.
firm_direct.detail: Twenty minutes. Pace up. Breath up. No phone scrolling — just walk.

gentle.title: Fifteen easy cardio minutes
gentle.detail: A pace where you could still chat. Nothing punishing — just steady, warm motion.

coach.title: Zone 2 cardio: 15 minutes
coach.detail: Conversational pace — talk-test passes. Build the aerobic base without taxing recovery.

firm_direct.title: Zone 2. 15 minutes.
firm_direct.detail: Conversation pace. No huffing. Fifteen minutes on the clock — go.

gentle.title: Bike or row for a quarter hour
gentle.detail: Choose whichever sounds kinder today. Fifteen minutes, no race, just movement.

coach.title: 15-minute bike or rowing session
coach.detail: Pick your machine — bike or rower. Steady cadence for fifteen minutes. Counts as cardio.

firm_direct.title: Bike. Or row. 15 min.
firm_direct.detail: Pick one. Bike or rower. Fifteen minutes. Steady cadence. Done.

gentle.title: Three gentle bodyweight rounds
gentle.detail: Squats, push, plank — your usual. Three rounds, listening to the body. No score to settle.

coach.title: Bodyweight circuit, 3 rounds
coach.detail: Squats, push-ups, plank. Three rounds with short rest between. Strength stays with use.

firm_direct.title: Circuit. 3 rounds.
firm_direct.detail: Squats. Push-ups. Plank. Three rounds. Short rest. Knock it out.

gentle.title: A set of push-ups when you can
gentle.detail: Ten push-ups whenever it suits — knees down is fine. The point is showing up.

coach.title: 10 push-ups today
coach.detail: One clean set of ten — knees-down or full, either works. Strength compounds in small reps.

firm_direct.title: Push-ups. Set of 10.
firm_direct.detail: Ten push-ups. Form first. Whenever — but today. Drop and go.

gentle.title: A half-hour strength session
gentle.detail: Your usual lifts, your usual pace. Thirty minutes that the body will thank you for tomorrow.

coach.title: 30-minute strength session
coach.detail: A real session — your usual movements, full warm-up, working sets. Thirty minutes of focus.

firm_direct.title: Strength. 30 min.
firm_direct.detail: Warm up. Working sets. Compound lifts first. Thirty minutes of actual work.

gentle.title: A few hundred steps over usual
gentle.detail: Aim for a small bump above your typical day. Five hundred extra is enough — no big push.

coach.title: +500 steps over your baseline
coach.detail: Add about five hundred steps to your normal day. Small daily increments compound.

firm_direct.title: +500 steps. Over baseline.
firm_direct.detail: Five hundred more than your usual day. Find them. Walk meeting, longer route, parking far.

gentle.title: A walk over lunch
gentle.detail: Step away from the desk midday. Ten minutes outside, or a slow loop indoors — both count.

coach.title: 10-minute lunchtime walk
coach.detail: Get up at lunch. Ten minutes of walking before or after eating. Resets the afternoon.

firm_direct.title: Lunch walk. 10 min.
firm_direct.detail: At lunch: stand up, walk ten. No phone meeting on the way. Pure walk.

gentle.title: A slow stroll after dinner
gentle.detail: Fifteen calm minutes once dinner is settled. No pace to hit — just be outside.

coach.title: 15-minute evening stroll
coach.detail: After dinner, fifteen minutes of easy walking. Helps digestion and the next day's sleep.

firm_direct.title: Stroll. After dinner. 15 min.
firm_direct.detail: Post-dinner: walk fifteen minutes. Easy pace. No screen. Phone in pocket.

gentle.title: Stand up once each hour
gentle.detail: Every hour you're sitting, rise for a moment. Stretch, sip water, look out the window.

coach.title: Stand once every hour
coach.detail: Through the workday: stand and move briefly each hour. Eight stands across the day.

firm_direct.title: Up every hour. 8 times.
firm_direct.detail: Each hour: stand. Move. Sit back down. Eight times across the day. Set a timer.

gentle.title: Walk between work blocks
gentle.detail: Every twenty-five minutes of focus, take two minutes to walk. Soft on the body, kind to focus.

coach.title: Walk between Pomodoros
coach.detail: Each 25-minute focus block: stand and walk for two. Four breaks today. Resets attention.

firm_direct.title: 25 work. 2 walk. ×4.
firm_direct.detail: Every 25 minutes of work: walk two. Four cycles. Phone stays at the desk.

gentle.title: A few stretches at your desk
gentle.detail: Three small stretch breaks somewhere in the day — neck, shoulders, hips. A minute each.

coach.title: 3 desk-stretch breaks today
coach.detail: Three short stretch sessions: neck rolls, shoulder openers, seated hip stretch. One minute each.

firm_direct.title: Stretch. ×3. At desk.
firm_direct.detail: Three desk stretches today. Neck. Shoulders. Hips. One minute each. No skipping.

gentle.title: Fifteen minutes outdoors
gentle.detail: Step outside for a quarter hour. The light, the air — both count even if you only sit.

coach.title: 15 minutes outside today
coach.detail: Fifteen minutes outdoors — walk, sit, stand, doesn't matter. Daylight and fresh air do the work.

firm_direct.title: Outside. 15 min.
firm_direct.detail: Fifteen minutes outdoors. Door, then out. Walk, sit, lean — but be outside.

gentle.title: A loop around a nearby park
gentle.detail: One slow circuit of a park or green block. Trees, sky, a little quiet. That's the rep.

coach.title: One park loop today
coach.detail: Find a park or green block, walk one full loop. Distance doesn't matter — the loop does.

firm_direct.title: Park loop. One.
firm_direct.detail: Pick a park. Walk the perimeter once. No half-loops. Then home.

gentle.title: Ten sunlit minutes
gentle.detail: Try to catch some daylight on a walk. Ten minutes is plenty to lift the mood.

coach.title: 10-min walk in daylight
coach.detail: Time a short walk for when the sun is out. Ten minutes of bright light helps sleep tonight.

firm_direct.title: Sun. 10 min walk.
firm_direct.detail: When the sun's out, walk ten. No sunglasses, no hood. Light on the face.

gentle.title: Five soft minutes of morning stretch
gentle.detail: Out of bed, slow stretches before the day starts. Reach, twist, breathe. Five minutes is enough.

coach.title: 5-minute morning stretch
coach.detail: Five minutes of mobility before the day starts. Forward fold, twist, side stretch. Wakes the body.

firm_direct.title: Stretch. AM. 5 min.
firm_direct.detail: Out of bed: five minutes of stretch. Forward fold. Twist. Side reach. Then start the day.

gentle.title: A short hip-mobility flow
gentle.detail: Hips love attention. Five minutes of slow openers — figure-fours, lunges, easy circles.

coach.title: 5-minute hip mobility flow
coach.detail: Five minutes targeting hips: figure-four, lunge with rotation, hip circles. Sitting all day adds up.

firm_direct.title: Hips. 5 min flow.
firm_direct.detail: Five minutes. Hip openers. Figure-four. Deep lunge. Circles. Loosen up.

gentle.title: A round of shoulder rolls
gentle.detail: Twenty slow rolls — back, then forward. The desk-shoulders will thank you.

coach.title: 20 shoulder rolls today
coach.detail: Twenty controlled shoulder rolls — ten back, ten forward. Counters the screen-hunch.

firm_direct.title: Shoulders. 20 rolls.
firm_direct.detail: Ten back. Ten forward. Slow and full. Reset the desk hunch. Done.

gentle.title: Take the stairs once today
gentle.detail: One time today, choose stairs over the lift. Small choices, made on purpose.

coach.title: One stairs-instead-of-elevator
coach.detail: Pick one elevator moment — take the stairs instead. Counts as movement. Counts as choice.

firm_direct.title: Stairs. Once.
firm_direct.detail: Skip one elevator. Take the stairs. One flight or ten — doesn't matter. Once.

gentle.title: Walk one errand instead
gentle.detail: If something nearby needs doing, walk to it. The errand counts twice — done, plus the walk.

coach.title: One errand on foot today
coach.detail: Pick a short errand — coffee, pharmacy, the corner shop — and walk instead of driving.

firm_direct.title: One errand. Walk it.
firm_direct.detail: An errand under a mile? Walk. No drive. Keys in the bowl. Shoes on. Go.

gentle.title: Park a little farther today
gentle.detail: When you arrive somewhere, choose a spot a few rows out. The extra walk adds up.

coach.title: Park farther — once today
coach.detail: Pick one stop — store, work, gym — and park a few rows farther than usual. Free steps.

firm_direct.title: Park far. One stop.
firm_direct.detail: One destination today: don't take the close spot. Park out. Walk in. Walk back.

gentle.title: A kind ten-minute walk
gentle.detail: Easy pace, easy distance. Ten minutes that asks nothing of you. Movement is the only goal.

coach.title: 10-minute easy walk
coach.detail: Ten minutes at a recovery pace — relaxed breath, slow legs. Helps next-day freshness.

firm_direct.title: Easy walk. 10 min.
firm_direct.detail: Ten minutes. Slow pace. Heart rate low. No music push. Just walk.

gentle.title: A short cooldown amble
gentle.detail: Five quiet minutes after a workout, or just because. Let the breath come back to even.

coach.title: 5-minute cooldown walk
coach.detail: Five minutes of slow walking after exertion or before bed. Brings heart rate down cleanly.

firm_direct.title: Cooldown. 5 min.
firm_direct.detail: Five minutes. Slow walk. Breath returns to normal. No checking the watch. Cool down.

gentle.title: Ten quiet stroll minutes
gentle.detail: A slow, soft walk for ten. No agenda — just legs moving and the day going by.

coach.title: 10-minute easy stroll
coach.detail: Ten unhurried minutes — flat ground, conversational pace. Easy on legs and lungs.

firm_direct.title: Stroll. 10 min.
firm_direct.detail: Ten minutes. Stroll pace. Don't push. Turn at five. Walk back.

gentle.title: Stand on one foot for a minute
gentle.detail: Try a minute on each foot — by the counter is fine, with a hand close by. A small balance practice.

coach.title: 1 minute single-leg stand
coach.detail: Stand on one foot for sixty seconds, then switch. Great for ankle stability and balance with age.

firm_direct.title: One foot. 60 sec.
firm_direct.detail: Sixty seconds, one foot. Then sixty on the other. No counter-grab unless you wobble.

gentle.title: A short heel-to-toe walk
gentle.detail: Twenty slow steps with one foot landing right in front of the other. Like a tightrope, on the carpet.

coach.title: 20 heel-to-toe steps
coach.detail: Walk in a straight line, heel meeting toe. Twenty steps. Sharpens balance and proprioception.

firm_direct.title: Heel-toe. 20 steps.
firm_direct.detail: Heel touches toe each step. Straight line. Twenty steps. Don't peek at the floor — chest up.

gentle.title: A balance moment, one leg at a time
gentle.detail: While brushing your teeth, lift one foot. Switch halfway. A small daily balance habit.

coach.title: Single-leg balance during a routine task
coach.detail: Stack it with brushing teeth or making coffee — stand on one leg for thirty seconds, then switch.

firm_direct.title: One-leg balance. Stack it.
firm_direct.detail: Brushing teeth — one foot up. Thirty seconds each side. Build the habit on a habit.

gentle.title: A deload-day walk
gentle.detail: On lighter days, a kind ten minutes is the whole goal. Movement, no measurement, no push.

coach.title: Deload day: 10-min walk
coach.detail: Recovery day. Ten minutes of walking — that's it. Resist adding intensity. Rest is part of training.

firm_direct.title: Deload. Walk 10 min.
firm_direct.detail: Recovery day. Ten minutes. Easy. No pace push. Rest is the work today.

gentle.title: A recovery-day walk
gentle.detail: On a tired day, a quarter hour of slow walking is plenty. Be kind. Tomorrow comes either way.

coach.title: 15-minute recovery walk
coach.detail: When the body's tired, walk fifteen at a slow pace. No music, no podcast — let the system reset.

firm_direct.title: Recovery walk. 15 min.
firm_direct.detail: Tired day. Walk fifteen. Slow. No headphones. Let the nervous system come down.

gentle.title: An easy-day stroll
gentle.detail: Fifteen calm minutes of strolling. Nothing to track, nothing to chase. Just the walk.

coach.title: 15-minute easy-day stroll
coach.detail: Easy day calls for easy work. Fifteen minutes of slow strolling — the body keeps its rhythm without taxing recovery.

firm_direct.title: Easy day. Stroll 15.
firm_direct.detail: Light day. Stroll fifteen. Don't pace-check. Don't extend. Walk and stop.
